title: Oetzi-Dorf Umhausen
highlights: Archaeologischer Freilichtpark zum Leben in der Jungsteinzeit vor rund 5300 Jahren
Lebensechte Rekonstruktionen von Huetten, Werkstaetten und Haustierrassen der Steinzeit
Mitmachstationen fuer Feuermachen, Bogenschiessen und vorgeschichtliche Handwerkstechniken
Direkte Nachbarschaft zum Greifvogelpark Umhausen und dem Stuibenfall
kurzbeschreibung: The Ötzi-Dorf in Umhausen is an archaeological park showcasing the fascinating daily life and crafts of people during the era of Ötzi the Iceman.
beschreibung:
Journey Back to the Neolithic Era

At the foot of the mighty Stuibenfall, the Ötzi-Dorf Umhausen transports visitors back to the world of 5,300 years ago. The archaeological open-air park impressively illustrates the living environment and survival strategies of the epoch when the famous Iceman roamed the Ötztaler Alpen.

Prehistoric Crafts and Ancient Animal Breeds

Across the grounds, visitors can explore faithful reconstructions of dwelling huts, storehouses, baking ovens, and smelting furnaces. Primitive domestic animal breeds such as woolly pigs, Przewalski's horses, and Soay sheep bring the village to life. Demonstrations of flintknapping and prehistoric fire-making make the Stone Age tangible for all senses.
